cohort: The study describes a single newborn patient presenting with omphalocele major and associated limb defects.
finding: A newborn delivered by Caesarian section presented with omphalocele major, an absent left lower limb, and right foot fusion defect, and was managed with topical povidone-iodine, leading to eschar formation and epithelisation of the sac.
mod_finding: The patient was delivered by Caesarian section, but no findings related to the impact of this mode of birth on outcomes were discussed.
followup_time: 1 week (initial discharge advice for regular follow-up)
